source.citation: Plummer, L. N., Busenberg, E. (1982). The solubilities of calcite, aragonite and vaterite in CO2-H2O solutions between 0 and 90 C, and an evaluation of the aqueous model for the system CaCO3-CO2-H2O. Geochimica et Cosmochimica Acta 46(6), 1011-1040.

transcription.from: the article's abstract, as quoted by indexing pages consulted on 2026-09-25; the article itself was not read
transcription.note: The value was typed into test/duan2016_reference.jl as 'the accepted log Ksp of calcite at 25 C' before this file existed. The abstract gives log K = -8.480 +/- 0.020 for calcite at 25 C, with -8.336 for aragonite and -7.913 for vaterite.

log_K_calcite_25C.description: log K of CaCO3(calcite) = Ca2+ + CO3-2 at 25 C.
